shared_preload_libraries.description: List of shared libraries to preload at PostgreSQL startup. Must include 'timescaledb' to enable the extension.

timescaledb_allow_version_below.description: Allow TimescaleDB to run on a PostgreSQL version newer than its last known compatible version. Only for testing.

timescaledb_allow_deprecated_guc.description: Allow use of deprecated GUC (configuration) parameters. Not recommended for production.

timescaledb_max_background_workers.description: Maximum total number of background worker processes (e.g., compression, continuous aggregates) across all databases.

timescaledb_max_background_workers_per_d.description: Maximum number of background worker processes allowed per database.

timescaledb_enable_background_workers.description: Enable resource tracking for background workers. Required for TimescaleDB to function properly.

timescaledb_compress_segmentby.description: Default column used for segmenting compressed data (usually 'time' or another high-cardinality column).

timescaledb_compress_time_interval.description: Default time interval for continuous aggregates and compression (e.g., '1day', '1hour').

timescaledb_telemetry_level.description: Telemetry level: 'off' (disabled), 'basic' (anonymous usage stats), or 'full' (includes crash reports).

timescaledb_extra_params.description: List of additional TimescaleDB-specific parameters to set (e.g., tuning chunk size, compression, or internal behavior).
